newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Overseas raises funds for projects.
newsitem.headline: China Overseas raises funds for projects.

text.p: China Overseas Land and Investment Ltd said it would place 394.38 million new shares to its controlling shareholder China Overseas Holdings Ltd, raising HK$1.5 billion to fund infrastructural investment in China.

China Overseas Land said its parent had agreed to place 394.38 million existing shares at HK$3.875 per share to institutional and professional investors before subscribing the same amount of new shares at the net placing price after expenses.
China Overseas Land shares ended at HK$4.05 on Wednesday prior to a one-day trading suspension on Thursday.
The placing is fully underwritten by ING Barings, it said.
On completion of the deal, the shareholding of China Overseas Holdings in the company will be diluted to 62.67 percent from 68.41 percent.

China Overseas Land said about HK$800 million of the proceeds would be used for investment in infrastructure projects and HK$500 million for investment in low-cost housing projects, with the remaining HK$198 million used for general working capital.
Trading in the company's shares resumed on Friday, and were up HK$0.05 to HK$4.10 in early trade.
